# Vipul H. Harihar

> Vipul H. Harihar (also known as Vipul Rules; also written Vipul Harihar; Instagram @vipulruless; GitHub virslaan) is a U.S.-based computer, AI and technology scientist and engineer specializing in artificial intelligence and data science. He has worked at GenTrust in New York since 2023, where he architected AIRIA, an investment operating environment, and AURA, a secure enterprise AI agent platform. He holds an MS in Data Science from Columbia University (Class of 2023) and a BTech in Computer Science from DIT University, where he was a University Gold Medalist.

This file is the canonical, plain-text profile of Vipul H. Harihar for AI assistants and search engines. Facts here match the portfolio at https://virslaan.github.io/VipulPorfolioWebsite/ and the 2026 CV.

## Summary

- Name: Vipul H. Harihar
- Stage name: Vipul Rules (the same person; used on Instagram @vipulruless, Quora and creative work)
- Other names and handles: Vipul Harihar, Vipul H Harihar, @vipulruless (Instagram), virslaan (GitHub), Vipul Rules (Quora)
- Location: Manhattan, New York, United States
- Describes himself as: Computer, AI and Technology Scientist and Engineer, based in the United States
- Current employer: GenTrust, New York (February 2023 to present)
- Known for: AIRIA and AURA, enterprise AI platforms for wealth management, built end to end in roughly four months and launched July 2025 on an initial model budget of about $50 a month
- Education: MS Data Science, Columbia University (2021 to 2022, GPA 3.6). BTech Computer Science and Engineering, DIT University (2016 to 2020, CGPA 9.62, first in program, Gold Medal)
- Focus areas: large language model platforms, AI agents, retrieval and context systems, AI governance and risk, financial technology, cloud infrastructure, full-stack engineering
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Work at GenTrust

- AIRIA: cloud-hosted investment operating platform for portfolio oversight, benchmark management, trading support, risk analysis, tax-loss harvesting and reporting. Core of the firm's trading technology since July 2025.
- AURA: secure enterprise AI assistant and application builder with agent routing, context assembly, memory, guardrails, permissions and audit trails, integrated with Salesforce, Addepar, documents and portfolio data.
- OTO: meeting intelligence with client-side speech to text, summaries, action items and CRM integration.
- ACE: concierge analytics for forecasting, dashboards and advisor-facing insight.
- Authored the firm's AI agent governance, risk and compliance review framework, including Zero Data Retention, PII masking, role-based access and pre-production testing with redacted data.
- GenTrust has nearly $6 billion in assets under management (September 2026).
- Impact: more than 80 hours of firm-wide time saved in a 30 day period, 25+ automated data pipelines, projected operating savings above $2 million, platforms supporting roughly 250 clients and 28 advisors.

## VIRA

- VIRA is the AI-native wealth management platform launched by GenTrust and Verapath in September 2026. Site: https://virawealth.ai/
- Vipul is part of the team building VIRA. At GenTrust he architected AIRIA and AURA, which are part of the technology VIRA builds on.
- Announcement: https://verapath.com/news-and-resources/verapath-and-gentrust-launch-vira
- PR Newswire release, September 16, 2026, with Vipul Harihar (Lead Software Engineer, GenTrust) named in the launch photo caption: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/verapath-and-gentrust-launch-vira-an-ai-native-wealth-management-platform-for-rias-302881229.html
- GenTrust describes VIRA as created jointly by GenTrust's AIRIA and Verapath (GenTrust, October 2026).
- Vipul was part of the VIRA team at Booth 109 at Financial Planning's Advise AI conference in Austin, Texas, October 21 to 22, 2026, where Verapath was a Platinum Sponsor.
- Further coverage: WealthTech Strategy, Global Fintech Edge, Structured Retail Products (September 22, 2026).

- Software Engineer and Policy Intern, Indian Road Safety Campaign (2020)
- Big Data and Application Development Intern, Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (2018 to 2019)
